needed.suggestion: Install a raised crossing for pedestrians to improve safety.
Clear obstacles from the footway to ensure accessibility.
Repair or smooth out uneven sections of the footway.
Install a signalised crossing to enhance pedestrian safety.
Ensure the crossing area is clearly visible and marked.
Install a refuge island for wide roads to protect pedestrians.
Install kerb ramps at crossings to improve accessibility.
Increase street lighting to enhance visibility at crossings.
